title: PH embassy in UK rejects inaccurate portrayals of Filipinos

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Embassy in London on Saturday pushed back against inaccurate portrayals of Filipinos in the United Kingdom following the circulation of a video about immigration and healthcare, calling for fair and respectful discussions about migrant communities. “The Embassy notes with concern recent portrayals of the Filipino diaspora in the United Kingdom that do not accurately reflect its character and contributions,” it said in a statement. The statement came after a video circulated showing a Filipino woman discussing how she received free healthcare in Britain, contrasting it with her experience in the Philippines, where she said she spent […]...
